pick.name: Gemini Omni Flash (Google; successor to Veo)
pick.what: Google's current video model: text/image/video to video with conversational editing, scene extension and up to 4K
pick.why: Google's flagship video generation after Veo; top-tier realism and audio plus multi-turn editing, in Flow, the Gemini app and the Gemini API.
pick.free_limits: No free tier: Gemini app/Flow video generation needs a Google AI Plus, Pro or Ultra plan; Gemini API paid tier only (video output $17.50 per 1M tokens, about $0.10/s at 720p). All Veo models in the Gemini API are shut down (Veo 2/3 GA on 30 Jun 2026, Veo 3.1 previews on 22 Oct 2026); replacement is gemini-omni-1.1-flash

best_free.name: Runway (free)
best_free.why: 125 one-time credits free; Standard $12/mo billed annually removes watermarks.
best_free.free_limits: 125 one-time credits (about 10 s of Gen-4.5); cannot buy credits on Free; all Free-plan videos carry a Runway watermark (Standard $12/mo annual or $15 monthly removes it). Commercial use allowed on all plans, no credit required

alts.name: Kling
alts.why: Free tier watermarked and non-commercial per secondary sources; paid Standard roughly $6.5-10/mo removes watermark.
alts.free_limits: Free: watermark, no commercial use (secondary sources)

alts.name: HyperFrames (code-driven video)
alts.why: Not generative; precise motion graphics from code.

candidates.name: Sora
candidates.verdict: DEAD: announced 24 Mar 2026; app closed 26 Apr 2026, API ends 24 Sep 2026 (secondary sources)

decision: Gemini Omni Flash, the successor to Veo, leads on quality, audio and conversational editing. No generative video tool has a free tier that suits commercial work: Runway's free output is watermarked, and open-weight Wan 2.2 (Apache-2.0) needs a 24 GB GPU or paid hosting. Sora is shut down (app 26 Apr 2026, API 24 Sep 2026).
details: Sora shutdown confirmed by OpenAI: web/app ended 26 Apr 2026; Videos API and sora-2/sora-2-pro shut down 24 Sep 2026 with no replacement. Veo replaced by Gemini Omni Flash.

verify.note: The pick is named Veo, but Veo endpoints are shut down in the Gemini API and Omni replaced Veo in the Gemini app. The file's '$0.10/sec Omni Flash' figure already silently referred to the new model. The Sora claim is confirmed by an official source: https://help.openai.com/en/articles/20001152-what-to-know-about-the-sora-discontinuation

better.name: Wan 2.2 (open weights)
better.reason: Apache-2.0 code and weights: genuinely free commercial use without watermark, but TI2V-5B needs a 24 GB GPU (or paid cloud GPU).
